title: Archaeologists Thought These Cannibalistic Ancient Humans Ate Children. They Were Only Half Right.
description: You may be familiar with some of humanity’s early relatives, like Homo erectus or Neanderthals. title: Is Assam's Ancient History Linked To The Ramayana And Mahabharata? Dr Sauradeep Nath Explains On Ranveer Allahbadia's BeerBiceps Podcast
description: Historian and author Dr Sauradeep Nath recently shed light on Assam's rich historical and mythological roots during an episode of Ranveer Allahbadia's BeerBiceps Podcast. During the conversation, Dr Nath explained how references in ancient Hindu texts, particularly the Ramayana, are often associated with the region now known as Assam, highlighting its deep cultural and historical significance.
